name: training-v2
title: The Training Mode Base Configuration, v2.0

ops.name: adjacent
ops.description: Two symbols seen side by side. The lateral behaviour, so concept mappings between letters read it. The v2.0 Base only. Nothing writes a link of this type yet.

fields.description: Represents the bond type of adjacency, the relation between two neighbouring objects that no link relates (for example a and c, or 1 and 2). An instance of bond-category, beside successor and sameness. Its intrinsic link length is long, so an adjacent bond is weak until one is built and the category becomes fully active. The v2.0 Base only.

row.name: adjacent
row.description: Neighbours that no other relation names. Abstractness is the node's conceptual depth. The v2.0 Base only.

fields.description: Notices a Letter object whose symbol has no letter-category description. If the symbol has a node it binds the object to it and proposes the ordinary description; if not it posts symbol-builder. The v2.0 Base only.

Makes the Slipnet node for a symbol that has none, connected to nothing, with apply_ops, binds the object to it and proposes the ordinary description. One add_node row per code point. The v2.0 Base only.
